title: A Balance of Iron and Salt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel earns its breadth by keeping those scales in contact.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Man Who Arrived Twice and its unsettling household delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Notice Jonah's forge, the clicking cart, and Kazi's continuing presence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These concrete details establish what abstract promises might otherwise erase.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow how the city's protection enters the family's choices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Keep Sofia's problem with truthful persuasion beside the question of continuity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book gives both questions enough time to disturb each other.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its invitation is to judge rescue from the lives receiving it.
